In this artifact, we provide a fully practical implementation of SuperF. The provided implementation is complex because it is intertwined with MLscript, a nascent functional programming language intended for real-world usage. While this has the advantage of demonstrating that our approach scales to realistic use cases and is practical for general-purpose programming, it means one needs to squint quite a bit to relate the provided implementation with the approach described in the paper.
